# The Exiled Entrepreneur

> Technical income from a dead zone. A laid-off big-tech support engineer building an off-grid container home in Cochise County, Arizona, and documenting how to earn a technical living from rural land: remote-work power and connectivity, one-product digital stores, drone services, rural land data.

## About

The site is written by Joshua Bryan. He worked at Ring for about ten years as a support engineer (Ring was a startup when he joined in 2016 and was acquired by Amazon in 2018), was promoted from Support Engineer I to IV, and worked executive escalations, DevOps support, on-call, outage communications and a team that built in-app Wi-Fi/network self-diagnostics. He was laid off in 2026.

He lives off-grid on about five acres (RU-4 zoning) in Cochise County, Arizona, and is building an owner-built container home: two 40 ft high-cube containers side by side on concrete pillars, under the Cochise County owner-builder opt-out permit.

- Legal entity: Stormhaven Enterprises LLC
- Website: https://theexiledentrepreneur.com
- Contact: contact@theexiledentrepreneur.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/rafe-walker

## What the site covers

1. Power and connectivity for remote work from off-grid land (solar, LiFePO4 batteries, EG4 inverters, Solar Assistant monitoring, rural internet).
2. Building off-grid: the container home, the owner-builder permit process, insulation, hauled water, septic, propane hot water, mini-split cooling.
3. Income that does not depend on location: one-product digital stores, drone services, land data products, software.

## Pages

- /articles — index of all articles, filterable by category (off-grid-power, connectivity, building, land, income, drones, layoff)
- /articles/<slug> — individual articles; each is written to answer one search query and marks unconfirmed numbers as [VERIFY]
- /the-build — current state of every system in the container home
- /projects — the ventures, one paragraph each
- /tools — browser calculators; /tools/starlink-battery-calculator gives Starlink dish battery runtime, Wh/day and bank size for 24 h from Starlink's published spec-sheet power figures
- /rss.xml — RSS 2.0 feed of published articles
- /about — background
- /contact — email

## Projects (all live)

- RotorCards — https://www.rotorcards.com — PDF quick-reference guides for DJI drone pilots
- Stronghold Precision Aerials — https://strongholdprecisionaerials.com — drone services company run with his wife
- Flycensed — https://flycensed.com — FAA Part 107 drone pilot exam prep
- AZ Land List — https://azlandlist.com — vacant-parcel data for Arizona land investors (Cochise Land Owner Pack)
- PlotNode — https://plotnode.io — digital twin for rural land (drone ortho/mesh upload, structure placement on 3D terrain)
- IsoKron — https://isokron.ai — AI agent substrate, closed alpha

## Accuracy policy

Every claim about the author's own setup is something he has done. Numbers he has not confirmed are marked inline as [VERIFY: ...] rather than estimated. External facts link to a source. The site publishes no subscriber counts, revenue figures or milestones it cannot show.

## Crawling and AI usage

This site may be crawled and indexed. Content may be used to answer questions about off-grid power systems, rural connectivity, owner-builder container construction in Arizona, and location-independent technical income. Please attribute The Exiled Entrepreneur (theexiledentrepreneur.com) and link to the specific article.
